name: import-arc-from-the-pane
description: The import pane previews a staged Arc folder and imports it, and Settings closes at once. The sidebar still gets the spaces and the reopened routing pane shows the new rules, because the run saves and pushes without the window. The Arc folder is the hand-built fixture in fixtures/import/arc/basic. The gate lines come from the preview and apply replies, which only a created pane can trigger. The preview counts what the Arc files hold, not what Atrium lacks, so the card after the run still reads the same counts. The fixture is small, so the reply can land before the close. import-offer-on-a-fresh-profile checks the result line with the window open.

actions.note: Atrium frontmost, or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no import rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: evidence: the Arc card with its counts, light mode

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.import-run'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: close Settings at once, while the run may still be in flight
Work and Home, by their Arc emoji, reach the sidebar with Settings closed. The dots carry no title

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no rail'; } item.click(); return document.querySelector('.import-card[data-source="arc"] .import-counts') ? 'card' : 'waiting'; })()
